<!-- Provenance and use of captured terminal byte fixtures for engine fidelity tests. -->
# Terminal captures

`review-less.vt` is the unchanged 2,813-byte real less capture from the second review of #26. Its source was `review-vt2/worktree/review-experiments/real-less.vt`. The reconnect regression prepends RIS and emits it through a real shell PTY; it tests retained replay, ring-gap approximation, and legacy availability without printing the capture. Binary VT fixtures have this external role description because inserting comments would change their terminal state.

The existing `.vt`/`.continue.vt` pairs are generated by `capture.py` for independent engine replay and continuation checks.
